{{Quote|The Ravagers. Terrors of sea and sky. They got a motto: "Why leave 'em alive when you can kill 'em?" Not the cleverest, granted, but it is appropriate.|Ruugar|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ravagers''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang that was headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before the [[Galactic War]], the Ravagers were involved in the infamous [[Ravager Raids]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Rishi]], the Ravagers' captain [[Ruugar]] was ousted by his lieutenant [[Coratanni]], and Ruugar enlisted aid in killing Coratanni.
